name: Gruha Lakshmi Scheme: Frequently Asked Questions
description: FAQ sheet from the Karnataka Women and Child Development Department on the Gruha Lakshmi scheme, which pays Rs 2,000 per month to the woman head of a family. It covers purpose, eligibility (head named on Antyodaya, BPL or APL ration card; excluded if she or her husband pays income tax or files GST returns), how to apply (Seva Sindhu portal, Grama One, Bangalore One, Karnataka One), required documents (Aadhaar, bank passbook) and timelines (applications from 16 June 2023, payments from 15 August).

name: Karnataka State Girl Child Policy 2018 (with Government Proceedings adopting it)
doc_number: Government Order No. MMLA 114 MBAB 2017 (as printed, OCR), dated 15.03.2018
description: State policy of the Department of Women and Child Development (and Empowerment of Differently Abled and Senior Citizens), adopted by government proceedings after Cabinet approval in February-March 2018; it follows the 2015 budget announcement of a girl-child policy covering exploitation, prohibition of child marriage and malnutrition. Objectives include ending sex-selection discrimination, equitable immunisation, nutrition and health services, free and compulsory education to age 18 or Class 12, life-skills training and girls' participation in decisions affecting them. A state-level committee under Veeranna Mattikatti drafted it.
reason: State girl-child policy incl. child marriage and exploitation prevention

description: Kannada-language SOP guidebook from the Karnataka Women and Child Development Department on preventing human trafficking, with forewords from the then WCD Minister Shashikala Jolle and the Chief Secretary. description: Karnataka Gazette (Part IV-A, 16 January 2018) republishing the state rules made under section 19 of the Prohibition of Child Marriage Act, 2006, issued by the Women and Child Development Ministry after the draft invited objections.
